# BiologicalPlausibilityScoring

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A quantitative framework that evaluates how closely a spiking neuron model's dynamics match biological neural behavior using optimization-based assessment. Enables automated validation of neuromorphic designs against biological benchmarks, bridging computational efficiency and neural fidelity.
